comparison.title: Encounter comparison
comparison.noBase: No percentage baseline: there were no encounters in the previous period.
comparison.rising: The count increased. Review scheduling and workload distribution before proposing capacity changes. The change alone does not establish its cause.
comparison.falling: The count decreased. Review demand and record completeness before proposing capacity changes.
comparison.stable: The count stayed the same. Check the date and area distributions before concluding that workload was identical.

insights.title: How to interpret and use these results
insights.analytics: Each encounter is a recorded episode; a patient may have several. Statuses describe the records when the analysis runs.
insights.snapshotScope: Dates filter encounters. Registered patients is the global catalog; beds and studies reflect their current state rather than historical occupancy. Area applies to encounters, beds and studies using the currently recorded area.
insights.met: The trend counts admissions, not unique people. The daily average includes calendar days with no admissions within the selected period.
insights.clinical: Each mean is based on the valid observations shown on its card. Observed minima and maxima describe the dataset; they are not recommended clinical limits. Compare only values with the same unit.
insights.unsupervised: Each group contains complete observations with similar vital signs. Group numbers identify sets and may change across runs. Groups are not diagnoses or unique patients.
insights.quality: Used {{used}} of {{total}} observations; {{excluded}} were excluded because of incomplete or unusable values.
insights.excludedDates: {{count}} records without valid dates were excluded when applying the period.
insights.morePeaks: {{count}} dates are tied; the first ten are shown.
insights.action_analytics: Identify areas with the most open encounters and review whether beds and study requests need operational attention. Record a concrete action and how you would evaluate its outcome.
insights.action_met: Use peak dates to review resource scheduling and check whether the pattern recurs in other periods.
insights.action_clinical: Review the quantity and quality of observations with the clinical team before interpreting a change or proposing an action.
insights.action_unsupervised: Compare group means against the overall mean of the observations used. Review exclusions before deciding whether data capture needs improvement or a pattern needs investigation.
insights.referenceMean: Overall mean of the observations used
insights.groupMeaning: These means describe the group observations. The dashed line in each profile chart marks the overall mean as a reference.
